definition.detected: the search returned a signal within 1% of the injected period, in phase with it
definition.recovered: detected, and the signal passed every cut (SNR >= 10, SDE >= 9, >= 3 transits) and every vetting check, so it would have become a candidate
definition.injection: box-shaped transit multiplied into the real light curve before detrending; radius and period log-uniform within each bin; impact parameter uniform 0-0.7; duration from the star's TIC density
definition.quiet_star: its own search found no signal passing SNR >= 10, SDE >= 9 and >= 3 transits
